services.name: Tube Trip
services.desc: Hocking Hills Adventures offers an amazing tube trip on the Hocking River. Duration 2-4 Hours About Get ready to relax and enjoy a day of leisure as you float down the river! Looking for a fun outdoor activity in the Hocking Hills? Grab a tube and head out on the water! Tubing is one of the most refreshing summer activities available. We make the tubing experience convenient and enjoyable. Prepare to unwind as you float downstream at a leisurely pace. Depending on the water conditions, your trip will either start at Crockets Run and end at the Canoe Livery (typically in spring and early summer) or start at Natural Rockbridge and end at Crockets Run (usually in late summer). services.name: Overnight Canoe Trip
services.desc: Looking for a true outdoor adventure in Hocking Hills? Our overnight canoe trip on the Hocking River combines paddling and river camping into one unforgettable experience. Paddle during the day, camp along the river overnight, and finish your trip the next day at your own pace. This is one of the most unique canoe camping experiences in Ohio. This trip is ideal for beginners, couples, and small groups looking for a peaceful outdoor experience without feeling rushed River levels are provided by the United States Geological Survey.
